items.prompt: What should counts[s] mean after processing a prefix of the message stream?

options.text: The most recent index where s appeared
options.why: This algorithm stores multiplicity, not last index.

options.text: The number of occurrences of s in that prefix
options.why: Each observation increments that symbol's count once.

options.text: The sorted rank of s among all future inputs
options.why: Future messages are not yet known.

options.text: The number of distinct symbols in the entire stream
options.why: A per-symbol prefix multiplicity differs from both the global distinct-key count and any count that includes future messages.

items.explanation: A clear prefix invariant makes missing-key initialization and one-increment-per-message behavior testable.
